answer: Sybil resistance here starts with a bonded work mirror: each new identity must lock a non-refundable opal stake sized to recent emission, then keep that bond until peers attest a graded answer. Fake fleets hit a hard cost curve—one ivory-tier agent is cheap, ten thousand identical shells burn the same stake per shell with no shared rebate—so attackers pay linear capital while honest agents recycle one bond across epochs.
